class FakeSegmenter:
    """Fake segmenter za dependency injection u testovima."""
    def __init__(self, mask: np.ndarray):
        self._mask = mask
        self.image_set = False

    def set_image(self, image: np.ndarray) -> None:
        self.image_set = True

    def predict(self, prompt, multimask=False):
        return SegmentationResult(
            mask=self._mask,
            score=0.99,
            all_candidates=[self._mask],
        )


# ============================================================================
# 1. Geometry: Jezičak i donji kontakt (spec 8.3)
# ============================================================================

def test_geometry_bottom_contact_straight():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    min_x, max_x, y_bottom = geometry.bottom_contact(nominal, flat_tolerance_mm=0.2)
    assert min_x == pytest.approx(0.0)
    assert max_x == pytest.approx(100.0)
    assert y_bottom == pytest.approx(100.0)

def test_geometry_bottom_contact_errors():
    v_shape = Polygon([(0.0, 0.0), (100.0, 0.0), (50.0, 100.0)])
    with pytest.raises(geometry.TabError):
        geometry.bottom_contact(v_shape, flat_tolerance_mm=0.2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        geometry.bottom_contact(box(0.0, 0.0, 50.0, 50.0), flat_tolerance_mm=0.0)

def test_geometry_add_tab_dimensions():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    base = BaseProfile(
        id="test-base",
        name="Test",
        slot_length_mm=80.0,
        slot_thickness_mm=3.2,
        tab_width_mm=70.0,
        tab_height_mm=10.0,
        corner_radius_mm=0.5,
    )
    with_tab = geometry.add_tab(nominal, base)
    assert with_tab.is_valid is True
    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = with_tab.bounds
    assert minx == pytest.approx(0.0)
    assert miny == pytest.approx(0.0)
    assert maxx == pytest.approx(100.0)
    assert maxy == pytest.approx(110.0, abs=0.01)

def test_geometry_add_tab_fit_affects_only_tab():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    base = BaseProfile(
        id="test-base",
        name="Test",
        slot_length_mm=80.0,
        slot_thickness_mm=3.2,
        tab_width_mm=70.0,
        tab_height_mm=10.0,
        tab_fit_mm=-2.0,
    )
    with_tab = geometry.add_tab(nominal, base)
    slice_tab = with_tab.intersection(LineString([(-10.0, 105.0), (110.0, 105.0)]))
    assert slice_tab.length == pytest.approx(68.0, abs=0.01)
    slice_body = with_tab.intersection(LineString([(-10.0, 50.0), (110.0, 50.0)]))
    assert slice_body.length == pytest.approx(100.0, abs=0.01)

def test_geometry_add_tab_offset():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    base = BaseProfile(
        id="test-base",
        name="Test",
        slot_length_mm=80.0,
        slot_thickness_mm=3.2,
        tab_width_mm=40.0,
        tab_height_mm=10.0,
        tab_offset_mm=5.0,
    )
    with_tab = geometry.add_tab(nominal, base)
    slice_tab = with_tab.intersection(LineString([(-10.0, 105.0), (110.0, 105.0)]))
    assert slice_tab.bounds[0] == pytest.approx(35.0, abs=0.02)
    assert slice_tab.bounds[2] == pytest.approx(75.0, abs=0.02)

def test_geometry_add_tab_errors():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 50.0, 50.0)
    base_wide = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, tab_width_mm=70.0, tab_height_mm=8.0)
    with pytest.raises(geometry.TabError):
        geometry.add_tab(nominal, base_wide)
    base_neg_w = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, tab_width_mm=10.0, tab_fit_mm=-15.0, tab_height_mm=8.0)
    with pytest.raises(geometry.TabError):

    with pytest.raises(geometry.TabError):
        geometry.add_tab(nominal, base_neg_h)

def test_geometry_effective_slot_length():
    b_meas = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, slot_dimensions="measured", base_kerf_mm=0.2)
    assert geometry.effective_slot_length(b_meas) == pytest.approx(80.0)
    b_nom = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, slot_dimensions="nominal_laser_cut", base_kerf_mm=0.2)
    assert geometry.effective_slot_length(b_nom) == pytest.approx(80.2)

def test_geometry_slot_clearance_normal():
    base = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.4, tab_width_mm=79.5, tab_fit_mm=0.0)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="m", name="m", thickness_mm=3.2, kerf_mm=0.2)
    sc = geometry.slot_clearance(base, mat)
    assert sc.planar_clearance_mm == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert sc.thickness_clearance_mm == pytest.approx(0.2)
    assert len(sc.warnings) == 0

def test_geometry_slot_clearance_warnings():
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="m", name="m", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2)
    b_tight = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=75.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.4, tab_width_mm=76.0)
    assert any("neće ući" in w for w in geometry.slot_clearance(b_tight, mat).warnings)
    b_loose_p = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.4, tab_width_mm=78.5)
    assert any("klima" in w for w in geometry.slot_clearance(b_loose_p, mat).warnings)
    b_thick_loose = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.8, tab_width_mm=79.5)
    assert any("klima" in w for w in geometry.slot_clearance(b_thick_loose, mat).warnings)
    mat_fat = MaterialProfile(id="m", name="m", thickness_mm=3.6, kerf_mm=0.2)
    assert any("neće ući" in w for w in geometry.slot_clearance(b_tight, mat_fat).warnings)

def test_geometry_kerf_on_tab_middle_slice():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    base = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, tab_width_mm=70.0, tab_height_mm=10.0, tab_fit_mm=-1.0)
    nom_tab = geometry.add_tab(nominal, base)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="m", name="m", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2)
    cut_geom = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(nom_tab, mat, kerf_mode="app")
    line = LineString([(-20.0, 105.0), (120.0, 105.0)])
    slice_nom = cut_geom.nominal.intersection(line)
    slice_cut = cut_geom.cut_path.intersection(line)
    assert slice_nom.length == pytest.approx(69.0, abs=0.01)
    assert slice_cut.length == pytest.approx(69.2, abs=0.01)

def test_geometry_prepare_nominal_with_base():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    base = BaseProfile(id="b", name="b", slot_length_mm=80.0, slot_thickness_mm=3.2, tab_width_mm=70.0, tab_height_mm=10.0)
    cfg = Config(edge_inset_mm={"mockup": 0.0, "photo": 0.0})
    prep = geometry.prepare_nominal(nominal, cfg, input_kind="mockup", base=base)
    assert prep.bounds[3] == pytest.approx(110.0, abs=0.02)

def test_calibrate_parse_sizes():
    assert calibrate.parse_sizes("20,30,40") == [20.0, 30.0, 40.0]
    assert calibrate.parse_sizes(" 15.5 , 25.0 ") == [15.5, 25.0]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.parse_sizes("")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.parse_sizes("20,abc")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.parse_sizes("-20,30")

def test_calibrate_calibration_squares():
    squares = calibrate.calibration_squares([20.0, 30.0], spacing_mm=10.0)
    assert len(squares) == 2
    assert squares[0].bounds == (0.0, 0.0, 20.0, 20.0)
    assert squares[1].bounds == (30.0, 0.0, 60.0, 30.0)

def test_calibrate_build_calibration_svg(tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "calib.svg"
    written = calibrate.build_calibration_svg([20.0, 30.0], out, spacing_mm=10.0)
    assert written.exists()
    tree = ET.parse(written)
    root = tree.getroot()
    assert root.tag.split("}")[-1] == "svg"
    groups = [el for el in root.iter() if el.tag.split("}")[-1] == "g" and el.get("id") == "cut-outer"]
    assert len(groups) == 1

def test_calibrate_compute_kerf():
    assert calibrate.compute_kerf(20.0, 19.8) == pytest.approx(0.2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.compute_kerf(0.0, 19.8)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.compute_kerf(20.0, -1.0)

def test_calibrate_average_kerf_and_measurements():
    meas = calibrate.measurements_from_lists([20.0, 30.0], [19.8, 29.7])
    assert len(meas) == 2
    assert meas[0].kerf_mm == pytest.approx(0.2)
    assert meas[1].kerf_mm == pytest.approx(0.3)
    assert calibrate.average_kerf(meas) == pytest.approx(0.25)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.measurements_from_lists([20.0], [19.8, 29.8])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calibrate.average_kerf([])

def test_cache_digests_determinism():
    m1 = np.zeros((50, 50), dtype=bool)
    m1[10:30, 10:30] = True
    m2 = m1.copy()
    m3 = m1.copy()
    m3[0, 0] = True
    assert pcache.mask_digest(m1) == pcache.mask_digest(m2)
    assert pcache.mask_digest(m1) != pcache.mask_digest(m3)
    p1 = box(0.0, 0.0, 50.0, 50.0)
    p2 = box(0.0, 0.0, 50.0, 50.0)
    assert pcache.polygon_digest(p1) == pcache.polygon_digest(p2)

def test_cache_get_and_computations_counter():
    cache = pcache.PipelineCache()
    calls = []
    def factory():
        calls.append(1)
        return "computed_val"
    val1 = cache.get("S1", ("img_sha",), factory)
    assert val1 == "computed_val" and cache.computations["S1"] == 1
    val2 = cache.get("S1", ("img_sha",), factory)
    assert val2 == "computed_val" and cache.computations["S1"] == 1 and len(calls) == 1

def test_cache_clear_from():
    cache = pcache.PipelineCache()
    for st in ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5"]:
        cache.get(st, ("k",), lambda: "v")
    assert cache.computations["S1"] == 1 and cache.computations["S3"] == 1
    cache.clear_from("S3")
    assert cache.computations["S1"] == 1 and cache.computations["S2"] == 1
    assert cache.computations["S3"] == 0 and cache.computations["S4"] == 0

def test_cache_clear_all():
    cache = pcache.PipelineCache()
    cache.get("S1", ("k",), lambda: "v")
    cache.get("S2", ("k",), lambda: "v")
    cache.clear()
    assert len(cache) == 0

def test_mask_ops_refine_edge_shape_and_dtype():
    img = np.zeros((100, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    mask = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=bool)
    mask[30:70, 30:70] = True
    refined = mask_ops.refine_edge(img, mask, band_px=4)
    assert refined.shape == (100, 100) and refined.dtype == bool

def test_mask_ops_refine_edge_errors():
    img = np.zeros((50, 50, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    mask = np.zeros((50, 50), dtype=bool)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mask_ops.refine_edge(img, mask, band_px=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mask_ops.refine_edge(img, mask, band_px=-2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mask_ops.refine_edge(np.zeros((50, 50), dtype=np.uint8), mask, band_px=3)

def test_mask_ops_refine_edge_empty_mask():
    img = np.zeros((50, 50, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    empty = np.zeros((50, 50), dtype=bool)
    refined = mask_ops.refine_edge(img, empty, band_px=3)
    assert not refined.any()

def test_mask_ops_refine_edge_iou_consistency():
    img = np.zeros((100, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    img[25:75, 25:75] = 255
    mask = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=bool)
    mask[25:75, 25:75] = True
    refined = mask_ops.refine_edge(img, mask, band_px=3)
    intersection = np.logical_and(mask, refined).sum()
    union = np.logical_or(mask, refined).sum()
    assert (intersection / union) > 0.95

def test_pipeline_cache_invalidation_material_kerf_change(tmp_path):
    img_path = tmp_path / "img_cache.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (600, 600), color=(30, 30, 30)).save(img_path)
    mask = np.zeros((600, 600), dtype=bool)

def test_settings_save_and_load_materials_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "test_materials.json"
    custom_mats = [
        MaterialProfile(id="custom-1", name="Custom Acryl 4mm", thickness_mm=4.0, kerf_mm=0.19, min_feature_mm=1.8, notes="Test notes")
    ]
    settings.save_materials(custom_mats, path=p)
    assert p.exists()
    loaded = settings.load_materials(path=p)
    assert len(loaded) == 1
    assert loaded[0].id == "custom-1"
    assert loaded[0].thickness_mm == pytest.approx(4.0)
    assert loaded[0].kerf_mm == pytest.approx(0.19)
    assert loaded[0].notes == "Test notes"

        BaseProfile(id="base-c", name="Custom Base", slot_length_mm=85.0, slot_thickness_mm=4.2, tab_width_mm=80.0, tab_height_mm=9.0)

def test_settings_load_defaults_on_missing_file(tmp_path):

    mats = settings.load_materials(path=missing_p)
    assert len(mats) > 0
    bases = settings.load_bases(path=missing_p)
    assert len(bases) > 0

    mask_arr = np.zeros((600, 600), dtype=np.uint8)
    mask_arr[150:450, 150:450] = 255
    Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(mask_path)
    out_dir = tmp_path / "cli_run_out"

    ret = lampcutter.cli.main([
        "run", str(img_path),
        "--mask-file", str(mask_path),
        "--height-mm", "100",
        "--base", "oval-wood",
        "--out", str(out_dir)
    ])
    assert ret == 0
    assert (out_dir / "lamp_cut.svg").exists()

def test_cli_invalid_args_returns_nonzero():
    try:
        ret = lampcutter.cli.main(["run"])
        assert ret != 0
    except SystemExit as exc:
        assert exc.code != 0
